{{Youmay|the docking bay on [[Trendivar]]|the [[Docking Bay 73 (Tatooine)|docking bay]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] or the [[Docking bay 73|docking bay]] on a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world|linebreak=1}}
'''Docking Bay 73''' was located in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trendivar]]. Essentially a pit dug into the planet's surface, the walls of the bay were constructed with [[Plascrete/Legends|plascrete]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the site of a battle between [[Mennac Vanderijar|Mennac]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and her entourage and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] team [[Grim Destiny]].
